newsitem.title: USA: Marisa Christina sees 1997 EPS at $0.38.
newsitem.headline: Marisa Christina sees 1997 EPS at $0.38.

text.p: Marisa Christina Inc said Thursday that it has revised its estimate for the remainder of the year, expecting 1997 sales of about $105 million and net income of about $3.2 million or $0.38 per share.

The company said that while second quarter earnings were on target, the current operating environment remains very difficult. It said that although the redesigned Marisa Christina line has been well received, competition in the 'better' category remains intense and consumer demand in 'bridge' has fallen off in recent months, which will impact future results of the Adrienne Vittadini division.
The First Call consensus earnings estimate for company is $0.81 per share in 1997.

In a statement accompanying second quarter earnings, released today, chief executive Michael Lerner said, "We are disappointed that the tangible progress we have made this year will not be reflected in our 1997 results. Nonetheless, we are moving forward with the initiatives that we believe will restore our performance to its historic growth levels."
Marisa Christina designs, manufactures, sources and markets "better" and "bridge" clothing for women and children.
